identificationModule.briefTitle: Toripalimab Combined With Axitinib as Neoadjuvant Therapy in Patients With Non-metastatic Locally Advanced Nonmetastatic Clear Cell Renal Cell Carcinoma
identificationModule.officialTitle: Phase II Study of Toripalimab Combined With Axitinib as Neoadjuvant Therapy in Patients With Non-metastatic Locally Advanced Nonmetastatic Clear Cell Renal Cell Carcinoma

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This study is design to prospectively investigate the safety and efficacy of Toripalimab combined with Axitinib in downsizing tumors in patients with nonmetastatic biopsy-proven clear cell renal cell carcinoma. Toripalimab is new antibody that may help activate the immune system by blocking the function of an inhibitory molecule, Programmed cell death-1 (PD-1). This is a single-institution, single-arm phase 2 clinical trial.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: This study is design to prospectively investigate the safety and efficacy of Toripalimab combined with Axitinib in downsizing tumors in patients with nonmetastatic biopsy-proven clear cell renal cell carcinoma. Toripalimab is new antibody that may help activate the immune system by blocking the function of an inhibitory molecule, Programmed cell death-1 (PD-1). This is a single-institution, single-arm phase 2 clinical trial. Patients will receive axitinib 5 mg bid combined with Toripalimab 3mg/KG q3w for up to 12 wk. Patients then will receive partial or radical nephrectomy after neoadjuvant therapy.

conditions: Neoadjuvant Therapy of Non-metastatic Locally Advanced Renal Cell Carcinoma

interventions.name: Toripalimab
interventions.description: 240mg, IV (in the vein) on on day 1 of 3-week, 6-week and 9-week for a total of 3 doses prior to partial nephrectomy or radical nephrectomy

interventions.name: Axitinib
interventions.description: 5 mg by mouth twice each day for 12 weeks prior to nephrectomy

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Non-metastatic biopsy-proven clear cell renal cell carcinoma (T2-T3N0-1M0)
* Schedule to undergo either partial or radical nephrectomy as part of treatment plan
* ECOG performance status of 0 or 1
* Adequate organ and marrow function defined by study-specified laboratory tests
* Agree to comply with scheduled visits, treatment plans, lab tests and other study procedures
* Do not have any other cancers in the 5 yr preceding diagnosis of their renal cancer

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients who have received other systems for anti-tumor treatment
* Patients who have previously received targeted or immunotherapy
* Need for urgent or emergent nephrectomy to relieve symptoms
* Current use of immunosuppressive agents
* Pregnant or breastfeeding women
* History of autoimmune disease or syndrome
